en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of the ornate interior of a church, specifically the choir and altar area. Gothic-style stained-glass windows, ornate woodwork, and religious iconography are visible. Text at the bottom of the image identifies it as 'Sundsvalls kyrka, Interiör, koret.' The reverse side displays handwritten correspondence, address lines, and a green Swedish stamp (10 öre) with a lion motif.
